fields.description: Per-line VAT override template at the single rate of the company's purchase and sales tax templates (auto-provisioned: CARD VAT <rate>% - <abbr>).
fields.label: VAT item tax template (company rate)

fields.description: Per-line 0% VAT override template for non-taxable adjustment lines (auto-provisioned: CARD VAT 0% - <abbr>).
fields.label: VAT 0% item tax template

fields.description: A new diesel fill, or one whose company, equipment, project or date changed, needs each equipment assigned to the fill's project on the fill date. Warn only: a message, the fill is saved. Refuse: the fill is refused. Off: no check. Empty: Warn only. On the day of a project-to-project move the fill goes to the project the move-day rule gives that day: the old project when the new assignment starts the day after the move, the new project when it starts on the move day. Submitted fills are never checked again.
fields.label: Diesel fill project check
fields.options:
Off (diesel project check)
Warn only (diesel project check)
Refuse (diesel project check)

fields.description: Where an equipment of this company with no movement history (no assignment and no approved transport) is recorded, shown as From on its first transport. Empty: storage without a place.
fields.label: Initial place of new equipment

fields.default: New assignment starts the day after the move
fields.description: Project to project transport: the day after the move (the old project keeps the move day), or on the move day (the move day goes to the new project). Empty: the day after the move.
fields.label: Move-day rule
fields.options:
New assignment starts the day after the move
New assignment starts on the move day

fields.description: An equipment with status Ended on a new assignment, transport or monthly card: Warn only shows a message and saves; Refuse stops it. Never stopped: a return to the supplier, an owned machine moved to storage or a workshop, a card of the month of its exit. Existing records are never changed. Empty: Warn only.
fields.label: Equipment status rule

fields.description: A monthly card submitted (approved) by a user who created or edited it, or any card it amends: Warn only submits with a message and marks the card; Refuse stops the submit. No role is exempt. Empty: Warn only.
fields.label: Monthly card approval rule

fields.description: Empty: the main store in Card Settings (Materials). Must belong to this company.
fields.label: Main store

fields.description: Empty: the tool custody store in Card Settings (Materials). Must belong to this company. Change it only when no tool of this company is held in custody.
fields.label: Tool custody store

fields.description: Empty or 0: the value in Card Settings (Materials).
fields.label: Flag a repeated request within (days)

fields.description: A transport recorded with a responsibility scenario: Hold keeps it out of the monthly invoices (as before; the Transport Accounting Review lists it). Post adds it to the monthly draft invoices: the transporter's Purchase Invoice line, the customer's Sales Invoice line from the approved billing amount, and the equipment supplier's recovery as a deduction. Switch to Post only after the accountant and the tax adviser agree. Empty: Hold.
fields.label: Transport responsibility posting
fields.options:
Hold (transport responsibility posting)
Post (transport responsibility posting)

fields.description: Income account of the transport cost billed to a customer (Post only). Must be an enabled, non-group account of this company.
fields.label: Transport recharge income account

fields.description: A non-taxable customer-side deduction on a monthly card (ZATCA: no negative Sales Invoice lines, and a Net Total discount would change the VAT base): Refuse keeps today's behaviour (the posting is refused and the owner decides the representation). Credit note posts the deduction as a separate draft Sales Invoice with is_return=1 against the month's submitted Sales Invoice (standard ERPNext credit note), so the original invoice is never touched and no negative line appears on it. Switch to Credit note only after the tax adviser agrees. Empty: Refuse.
fields.label: Non-taxable customer deduction
fields.options:
Refuse (non-taxable customer deduction)
Credit note (non-taxable customer deduction)

fields.description: On: the monthly posting (draft Purchase and Sales Invoices) of a month is refused until the company's Card Period Run for that month is submitted, approved by an accountant and still current; every document the posting bills is checked against the run. Off (the default): posting as before.
fields.label: Require an approved period run before posting

fields.description: A period run approved by a user who built, edited or submitted it (or an earlier version): Warn only approves with a message and marks the run; Refuse stops the approval, and a run approved that way is not accepted for posting. The stricter of this rule and the run's own rule applies. Empty: Warn only.
fields.label: Period run self-approval rule

fields.description: How a tank diesel fill's litres are split per equipment for reports and the card (display only; the posting is unchanged — FR-100). Hours: share = hours / Σ hours (matches the FR-033 read-time estimate, the default). Hours × Rate: share = (hours × litres per hour) / Σ (hours × rate), with the FR-144 dated rate on the fill date. Empty: Hours.
fields.label: Tank diesel estimate weighting

fields.description: Optional net-amount thresholds that gate a monthly card's submit by role (FR-159). Empty: every card is tier 0 and any user with Card Monthly Card write may submit, current behaviour. With rows: a card whose net amount reaches a threshold needs the matching Role on submit; the highest matching threshold wins. The role_required is only enforced — this table grants no role or DocPerm of its own.
fields.label: Approval tier thresholds
